description: Source code for TransportConnectSubJob class and WebSocketStreamSocket wrapper, handling socket connection logic, endpoint locking, and socket performance monitoring within the Chromium net namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamSocket
classes.description: A wrapper around StreamSocket that manages registration with WebSocketEndpointLockManager on creation/destruction.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initiates the connection process, setting initial state.

methods.name: GotEndpointLock
methods.description: Callback invoked when endpoint lock is acquired.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state based on internal state.

methods.name: CurrentAddress
methods.description: Returns the current address being connected to.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of IO operations, progressing the connection loop.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop managing connection states and transitions.

methods.name: DoEndpointLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire endpoint lock if applicable.

methods.name: DoEndpointLockComplete
methods.description: Completes endpoint lock acquisition, creates socket, and initiates connection.

methods.name: DoTransportConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of transport connection, manages retries or success.
